resources.instructions: Price tables and binding quoting rules. Read before pricing.
Quote history and customer files. Check before pricing, update after.

initial_events.description: Draft quote for the RFQ in /mnt/session/uploads/rfq/

rubric.content:
- owner-brief-<number>.html exists, in Hebrew, RTL, and its sections appear in this order: "בשורה התחתונה", "החלטות שמחכות לך", "שאלות ללקוח", "מה בדקתי ומה הערכתי", "איך חושב"
- Every decision in the owner brief lists options with the price and lead-time effect of each option, and a short recommendation
- The owner brief prints on at most two A4 pages, and page one shows the bottom line and the decisions
- quote-<number>.html exists: shop header, quote number, date, valid-until, customer, lines with unit price and line total for every part and quantity asked, subtotal, VAT 18%, total, lead time, payment terms, assumptions, signature line; and it contains no internal codes (R1-R10, M1-M4)
- quote-<number>.xlsx exists with sheets "הצעה", "חישוב", "שאלות"; "חישוב" shows raw stock size and weight per part and cites a shop-pricing code for every rate; no price that is not in shop-pricing
- The same totals appear in the owner brief, the customer quote and the Excel
- Cycle times without a similar part in quote-history are marked as estimates with a range
- Every email/drawing conflict, missing drawing detail, and request outside rules.md is a decision or a customer question; none is resolved silently
- reply-<number>.md exists, in Hebrew, starts with "טיוטה - לא נשלח", and asks the customer questions
- /mnt/memory/quote-history/quotes/log.md has a new row for this quote, and customers/<customer>.md exists for this customer
